# NEW 2026-11-17 conquest campaigns (phase 1 + 2). Generated by gen_heg_campaigns.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ---- 埃及 ----
# Location scope.
oe_hc_egypt_location = { OR = { region = region:egypt_region area = area:levant_area } }
# Country scope: a country the campaign declares on (capital in the region, outside the Byzantine bloc).
# Decision 67 (2026-11-19, V3): army-type countries too, so the Golden Horde, the Jalayirids and the Chobanids
# can be targets; they hold locations and a capital like location-type countries.
oe_hc_egypt_target = {
    OR = { country_type = location country_type = army }
    NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes }
    capital ?= { oe_hc_egypt_location = yes }
}
# Country scope: still at war with BYZ in a war registered by this campaign.
oe_hc_egypt_target_active = {
    has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target
    NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes }
    is_at_war_with = c:BYZ
    custom_tooltip = {
        text = OE_HC_IN_CAMPAIGN_WAR
        any_current_war = {
            has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war
            OR = {
                AND = { is_an_attacker = c:BYZ is_a_defender = prev }
                AND = { is_a_defender = c:BYZ is_an_attacker = prev }
            }
        }
    }
}
# Location scope: captured land that the campaign transfers at once (capitals wait for the peace).
oe_hc_egypt_capture_allowed = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active }
    oe_hc_egypt_location = yes
    is_ownable = yes
    is_capital = no
    has_owner = yes
    controller = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes is_at_war_with = prev.owner }
    owner = { oe_hc_egypt_target_active = yes }
}
# BYZ scope.
oe_hc_egypt_declare_allowed = {
    oe_heg_campaign_access = yes
    custom_tooltip = { text = OE_HC_PLAN_REQUIRED has_variable = oe_heg_egypt_plan_done }
    custom_tooltip = { text = OE_HC_ONE_AT_A_TIME NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active } }
    custom_tooltip = { text = OE_HC_COOLDOWN NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_cd } }
    gold >= oe_hc_declare_cost
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        custom_tooltip = { text = OE_HC_AUTHORITY_10 var:oe_pillars_authority >= 10 }
    }
    custom_tooltip = { text = OE_HC_NO_TARGETS any_country = { oe_hc_egypt_target = yes } }
}
